confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cádiz and Andalusian coastal pricing; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July peak-season rates and dorm availability vary widely. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 3x and 1.2x beer) because direct knowledge of local bar prices is weaker. USD figures are approximate conversions of local euro price levels, not live-rate conversions.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Andalusian coastal tourism cities such as Málaga and Jerez de la Frontera: restaurant prices are below Madrid and Barcelona, and hostel and hotel anchors include a July peak-season uplift. No specific comparable listings were consulted.
